usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover the available sub-resources under the HA status tree (e.g., 'current' and 'manager_status'). It returns a directory listing of child endpoints, not actual HA state data — follow the child hrefs to retrieve live cluster status or manager details. No special privileges are required; any authenticated user can call this.

examples.summary: List HA status sub-resources on a cluster

tips: This is a directory index — use the returned 'name' values to construct child paths like /cluster/ha/status/current for live HA state.
Pair with get_cluster_ha_status_current to retrieve the actual quorum and resource health summary.
No query parameters are accepted; the response shape is fixed.
